dimensions.justification: Goal is to promote tourism to Velugu Cove. No specific measurable outcomes (e.g., number of enquiries) defined.
Target audience identified as tourists from Hyderabad and Bangalore. Mobile-first mentioned.
Needs for homestays (L7), restaurant (L8), and boat tours (L9) are clearly attributed to sponsors.
Implied sections for rooms, menu, and tours, but no formal page structure or site map defined.
WhatsApp contact button and content display mentioned, but details on maps or booking forms are missing.
Photos mentioned as important, but ownership and supply process are not defined.
No style, color, or branding requirements mentioned.
Mobile-first mentioned, but no other non-functional requirements like accessibility or SEO.
Budget and timeline mentioned, but maintenance and hosting responsibilities are unclear.
